name: agentsearch
description: Web search, URL-to-markdown extract, JS render and search_and_read for AI agents. Free keyless search (up to 25/day per IP) by default; optional wallet env for paid calls on AgentSearch's direct x402 API on Base.

settings.name: Wallet private key
settings.description: Optional. Private key of a Base USDC wallet for paid extract ($0.004), render ($0.010) and search_and_read ($0.009) on https://api.agentsearchhq.com. Leave empty for free keyless search and the extract/render trial.

settings.name: Search mode
settings.description: Optional. free (default, even with a wallet key), paid ($0.008 per search; needs a wallet key), or auto.
